Easy weeknight lentil soup

By Sam Ortiz · Updated Sep 1, 2026
Jump to Recipe

This soup takes thirty minutes, uses pantry staples, and tastes even better the next day.

Advertisement

Red lentils cook quickly and break down into a creamy texture without any blending.

Lentil soup

Prep: 10 min Cook: 20 min Serves: 4

Ingredients

  • 1 cup red lentils, rinsed
  • 1 onion, finely chopped
  • 4 cups vegetable stock

Instructions

  1. Cook the onion in a little oil until soft.
  2. Add the lentils and stock, then simmer for twenty minutes.
  3. Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon juice.

Calories230
Protein14 g
